mapper.insert: INSERT INTO reading_cache (user_id, algorithm, chart_fingerprint, question_hash, question, content, model, tokens_in, tokens_out, engine_version, hit_count, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{user_id}, #{algorithm}, #{chart_fingerprint}, #{question_hash}, #{question}, #{content}, #{model}, #{tokens_in}, #{tokens_out}, #{engine_version}, 0, #{now_at}, #{now_at}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE question = VALUES(question), content = VALUES(content), model = VALUES(model), tokens_in = VALUES(tokens_in), tokens_out = VALUES(tokens_out), engine_version = VALUES(engine_version), updated_at = VALUES(updated_at)
